title: Planetar Feather
summary: Refine three feathers into the extract for Potion of Angelic Slumber.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Planetar Feathers to make Essence of Planetar Feather, then combine with any Suspension for Potion of Angelic Slumber.
fields.Base value: 55 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
